technical-summary: Corrected cache-miss measuring admission to calculate per-rank host-pool, host KV, reserve, and TP from the exact strictly parsed measuring manifest while retaining fresh host room detection. Added resource API coverage and a session regression where exit 11 increases the requested pool, a second cache miss returns an unmeasured manifest, and the new effective TP3 allocation is refused before another measuring child starts. Incremental focused builds succeeded; bc_resources_parity_test and bc_serving_test passed. No GPU test or performance claim.
